question: Which of the following financial organizations was honored for the digital initiatives 'Pravah' and 'Saarthi' in March 2025?

options.text: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

solution:
The correct answer is __**भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** was recognized and honored in **March 2025** for its innovative digital initiatives aimed at transforming the regulatory landscape and improving financial literacy.
 
• The **'PRAVAAH'** portal, which stands for **Platform for Regulatory Application, Validation, and Authorisation**, was launched to provide a centralized **web-based** interface for entities to seek various regulatory approvals.
 
• This initiative aims to enhance the **Ease of Doing Business** by streamlining the licensing process, allowing for **real-time tracking** of applications, and reducing the time-frame for regulatory clearances.
 
• The **'Saarthi'** initiative (in the context of the 2025 recognition) focuses on **digital financial education** and protecting consumers from **cyber-frauds**, reinforcing the central bank's commitment to a safe digital payment ecosystem.
 
• These digital strides led to the **RBI** receiving accolades at international platforms like the **Central Banking Awards 2025**, where it was lauded for its **technological integration** in central banking.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI):**

 
 
• It was established on **April 1, 1935**, following the recommendations of the **Hilton Young Commission**.
 
• The **RBI Act, 1934** provides the statutory basis for its functioning. It was nationalized on **January 1, 1949**.
 
• The current Governor is **Shaktikanta Das**, who has been instrumental in navigating the **Indian Economy** through global challenges.
 
• The headquarters is located in **Mumbai**, **Maharashtra**.
 
 
 
• **Other Financial Organizations:**
 
 
• **SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India):** Established in **1988** and given statutory powers in **1992**. It regulates the **stock market** and protects investor interests. SEBI also has a mobile app named **'Saa₹thi'** for investor education.
 
• **NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India):** An initiative by the **RBI** and **IBA**, incorporated in **2008**. It manages retail payments like **UPI**, **IMPS**, and **RuPay**.
 
• **NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development):** Established on **July 12, 1982**, on the recommendations of the **B. Sivaraman Committee** to promote rural and agricultural development.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Digital Rupee (CBDC):** The **RBI** launched the pilot for the **Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC)** in **2022**, marking a significant milestone in India's **Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)**.
 
• **Regulatory Sandboxes:** **RBI** uses regulatory sandboxes to foster innovation in **FinTech**, allowing live testing of new products in a controlled environment.
 
• **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC):** A **six-member** committee headed by the **Governor** that decides the **Repo Rate** to control **inflation** within the target band of **4% (+/- 2%)**.
 
• **Antardrishti:** Another digital dashboard launched by **RBI** to monitor and improve **Financial Inclusion** across various strata of society.
